title: Children's wrist fractures and knee osteoarthritis grades
description: Eight wrist radiographs (frontal and lateral) of four children from GRAZPEDWRI-DX with the fracture boxed: two Salter-Harris II fractures of the distal radius and two incomplete (torus/buckle or greenstick) distal radius fractures, as coded in the dataset. Three knee radiographs (small crops of the joint) from Digital Knee X-ray Images with the Kellgren-Lawrence grade both experts gave (0, 2 and 4); grade only, no location.

sources.citation: Nagy E, Janisch M, Hržić F, Sorantin E, Tschauner S. A pediatric wrist trauma X-ray dataset (GRAZPEDWRI-DX) for machine learning. Sci Data. 2022;9:222. doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01328-z. Data: figshare doi:10.6084/m9.figshare.14825193.v2
sources.accessNote: dataset.csv and folder_structure.zip (annotations) from figshare; the selected 16-bit PNGs read member by member (HTTP Range, CRC-32 checked) from images_partN.zip. No login.

referenceTargets.label: Fracture: distal radius, Salter-Harris type II (radiologist box)

provenanceDetail.method: Fracture box from the dataset's annotations, which pediatric radiologists reviewed at least twice (Nagy et al. 2022); converted from pixel-corner to pixel-centre coordinates (-0.5 px). The fracture type in the label is read from the AO/OTA pediatric code in dataset.csv (E/2 = Salter-Harris II; M/2 = incomplete, torus/buckle or greenstick).
provenanceDetail.note: AO/OTA pediatric code 23r-E/2.1 (dataset.csv); age 13.9 y, F, side L.

referenceTargets.unassessedNote: Only the fracture is boxed; the ulna, carpal bones and soft tissues are not referenced.
referenceTargets.teachingNote: Salter-Harris II: the fracture runs along the growth plate and out through the metaphysis (AO PCCF E/2).
